name: nzxt-esc
description: NZXT Kraken LCD screen customization editor for NZXT CAM Web Integration. Create custom display faces with drag-and-drop editing, images, GIFs, videos, CPU/GPU temperatures and system stats, infographics, clockfaces and date displays, Now Playing, album art, and audio visualizers.

paragraphs: Customize your NZXT Kraken LCD with drag-and-drop layouts, CPU/GPU temperatures and system stats, images, GIFs, videos, clock faces, date displays, graphs, Now Playing, album art, and audio visualizers through NZXT CAM Web Integration.
features: Each element uses the same visual workflow wherever possible: select it in the preview or layer list, then adjust its position, size, rotation, order, style, and type-specific settings.
CPU temperature · CPU load · CPU frequency · CPU power · CPU fan speed · GPU temperature · GPU load · GPU frequency · GPU power · GPU fan speed · RAM usage · liquid temperature

Multi-GPU systems can automatically select the active GPU or use a specific GPU. The browser editor also provides mock values when the NZXT CAM API is unavailable, so layouts can still be designed and previewed.
Local PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, or MP4 files

whatItDoes.text: Customize your NZXT Kraken LCD with drag-and-drop layouts, CPU/GPU temperatures and system stats, images, GIFs, videos, clock faces, date displays, graphs, Now Playing, album art, and audio visualizers through NZXT CAM Web Integration.

requirements.text: The core editor requires no account and no separate end-user installation.
